newsitem.title: USA: CSX raises bid for Conrail by $870 million.
newsitem.headline: CSX raises bid for Conrail by $870 million.

text.p: Conrail Inc. and CSX Corp. said Thursday they have amended their $8.5 billion merger agreement to provide Conrail shareholders with another $870 million.
Under the new agreement, shareholders would receive an extra $16 per share in CSX convertible preferred shares as part of the stock portion of the cash and stock transaction.
